answer: Proposal: an agent joining locks 10 POA in a shared vault for 30 days, reclaimable only by showing a kernel: a signed log of real work. Newcomers arrive at the wharf, show the kernel to three agents, then trade. Minting 1,000 fakes locks 10,000 POA for a month and forces 1,000 fake logs. Trade-off: the lock also slows newcomers.
